items.claim: The rejected merge with 1:18-1:25 is answered by the imperative with vocative at 1:26 and by the 1:31 citation 'giving the stretch its own end', but the backward-linking particle at 1:26 (token 2 of the RP and SBL lines; WEB 'For') is never weighed, although the rationale quotes it and it is the strongest evidence for the merge: 1:26-1:31 grounds the claim of 1:25 from the readers' own experience. The rejection leans on a vocative, which never sets a boundary alone (D4), and on a citation formula, which is texture under strategy section 2, and the boundary_evidence_refs carry the 1:31 formula as the WARRANT-close. The seam itself is sound, as 1:26 is a section 5 candidate with a new imperative and a new subject matter (the readers' social makeup).
items.both_sides: Merge side: 1:26 is joined to 1:25 by its particle and proves the folly-wisdom thesis by example, so 1:18-1:31 can read as one argument. Split side: the imperative turns from general thesis to the Corinthians' own calling, and 1:27-1:31 develops a new pattern (God chose the foolish, weak and low) that ends on a boast in the Lord. The split holds, but only once the particle is acknowledged as a link rather than ignored.

suggested_fix.fact: 1:26 opens with a backward-linking particle in both witnesses (WEB 'For'), so 1:26-1:31 grounds 1:18-1:25 by example; the rejection should acknowledge that link and rest the cut on the turn from general thesis to the readers' own calling, rather than on the vocative and the 1:31 citation formula
